I picked A on physical reasoning plus a weak correlation, not from a causal-discovery test. In the data, Residual_RH and Residual_longwave have a correlation of only -0.08. Physically, humidity drives surface longwave flux, because water vapor and cloud change the downward longwave radiation. The reverse direction is less plausible. Direction can't be read off a correlation, so this rests on the physical argument.

ANSWER: A
